description: This file defines the TCPStore class used for distributed key-value storage in PyTorch, including configuration options, class declarations, and method signatures for TCP-based communication.

classes.name: TCPStore
classes.description: A distributed key-value store class for TCP communication, supporting various operations like get, set, add, delete, and queue management, with configuration options for server mode, threading, and libUV backend.

classes.name: TCPStoreOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for TCPStore, including port, server mode, number of workers, timeout, multi-tenancy, and backend choice.

classes.name: SocketAddress
classes.description: Structure representing a network socket address with host and port.

methods.name: TCPStore
methods.description: Constructor initializing TCPStore with host and options.

methods.name: ~TCPStore
methods.description: Destructor for TCPStore.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the TCPStore instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store.

methods.name: compareSet
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-set operation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a delta to a key's value.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the store.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple keys.

methods.name: getNumKeys
methods.description: Returns the number of keys.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for specified keys to be available.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to a key.

methods.name: multiGet
methods.description: Retrieves multiple keys at once.

methods.name: multiSet
methods.description: Sets multiple keys at once.

methods.name: hasExtendedApi
methods.description: Checks if extended API is supported.

methods.name: queuePush
methods.description: Pushes data onto a queue.

methods.name: queuePop
methods.description: Pops data from a queue.

methods.name: queueLen
methods.description: Returns length of a queue.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys.

methods.name: waitForWorkers
methods.description: Waits for all worker processes to join.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname used by the store.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port used by the store.

methods.name: isLibUvBackend
methods.description: Checks if libUV backend is used.

methods.name: _splitSet
methods.description: Internal testing function to split set data.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the store.

methods.name: incrementValueBy
methods.description: Increments a key's value by a delta.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks server responsiveness.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates store state.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Internal method to get data for a key.

methods.name: doWait
methods.description: Internal method to wait for keys with timeout.
